title: Person
description: A person. Holds no authentication secret: password hashes, reset tokens and auth providers belong to the system that authenticates.

wallet.description: ed25519 public key, hex. Identifies the person. Absent until they hold one.

localIds.description: The id this person has in each system that holds a record of them.

displayName.description: The name they are known by.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, where they are registered.

taxIds.description: Their tax or registry identifiers, one per scheme.
